english: The driver gave him a few biscuits and a cup of coffee and left him just outside the city.
text: left him just outside the city 是把他留在城外很近的地方，不必理解成冷酷地抛弃。leave someone 加地点只交代留下的位置；just 在这里缩小距离，不能按“刚刚”理解成时间。
author: Codex
